programmes.d: A man that has been arrested soliciting money is doing it again; a disturbance call is made when a father-in-law threatens a couple with knives because he thinks they stole his drugs.
A high speed chase ensues when cops go after a stolen truck; a daughter calls the cops on her father when he threatens to kill her because she was accusing him of cheating on her.
A high-speed chase starts when three suspects refuse to pull over; officers get a bank robbery call but hear the suspect leave the building.
A homeless man is sleeping in a handicap parking spot but when officers arrive, he resists arrest; officers pull over a car for a traffic violation and find 700 ecstasy pills.
Officers respond to a phone call from a man saying he wants to kill himself; an 18-year-old girl is arrested for prostitution on the Las Vegas strip.
A truck chase ends when he pulls off the side of the road and runs through a field; a driver takes off on foot after a high-speed chase ends in a collision.
Officers try to stop a motorcyclist after he weaves in and out of lanes and has no plate on his bike; officers pose as drug buyers and catch a man dealing drugs.

Officers search a man who they have just pulled over, but he takes off on foot; officers find a man who just broke into a house very paranoid, on drugs and claiming someone is out to kill his family and rape his daughter.
Officers see a vehicle hit a biker and immediately respond to the accident; a boyfriend assaults his girlfriend and her family and is taken into custody.

Cops chase after an automobile that ran a stop sign, the suspect eventually hits another car and is arrested for driving without a license and drug possession; a female is arrested when marijuana and cocaine are found in her car.
A man hits a pedestrian and runs but is caught, tasered, and faces many charges including resisting arrest, hit-and-run, and driving without a license; cops arrest a man for stealing a Porsche.
Cops pull over a motorcyclist who refuses to stop at a traffic signal; cops respond to a fight that breaks out in a nearby parking lot.
Several armed men at a nearby home are arrested for assaulting people and attempting to run from cops; cops find a busted-in window of a car with a man in the front seat who claims it's his car.
Officers get a call about a man kicking out car windows; a male is arrested for attempting to steal a car at a strip mall; officers respond to a fight at a local residence.
A man who is out on bond for grand theft auto is arrested again for trying to steal a car; two men are arrested for threatening a woman when she sees them beating up her neighbor.

Cops chase a car that just left a known drug house, but when the suspect is pulled over, he is arrested for felony of evasion and tampering with evidence; a K-9 unit finds cocaine under the passenger seat of a car and three suspects are arrested.

A suspect bails from a car that he stole after he crashes it and hides in some bushes; cops are dispatched to a mobile home park where a woman says she is tired of being verbally abused by her husband.

A domestic dispute call is made when a mother calls the cops on her daughter and boyfriend for fighting; a drunk man is fighting in a park with his girlfriend and is placed under arrest for the suspicion of driving drunk.

Cops get a call for an accidental shooting, but when they arrive at the scene and see a deceased man, evidence points to foul play; a man is arrested in an undercover drug deal and prostitution solicitation; a traffic stop.
Cops chase after two males in an SUV until it flips; a domestic disturbance call is made involving a child custody dispute; officers detain and tase a fleeing suspect for selling heroin.

Officers stop a man on a bike who matches the description of a robbery suspect, the man runs until he falls and is arrested; three men are detained when found hanging out in a heavy drug alley; a boyfriend is arrested for pushing his girlfriend.

Officers find a man in someone else's home who is wanted for domestic violence restraining order and a burglary; a man tries to swallow a bag of weed as he is pulled over; a woman stabs another man in the arm with scissors and is arrested.

Police ask a man to step out of his car when they spot marijuana, when he does, he run and hides under a car and is held at gunpoint until he comes out; a female is detained for stabbing a man with scissors and drug possession.
